components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary Button from the implemented command-center button cascade.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;height:36px;padding:0 13px;border:1px solid var(--line-2,#3d484e);border-radius:6px;font:500 13px/1 var(--sans, Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);background:var(--ac,#64d4bd);color:#0f2822;font-weight:650;border-color:var(--ac,#64d4bd);}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:#9de8d9}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ac,#64d4bd);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px) scale(.985)}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Brief Field
components.description: A visible label, inset fill, and teal focus for website briefs.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Describe your website<textarea placeholder="Describe the result you want"></textarea></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:block;font:500 12px/1 var(--sans, Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);color:var(--tx-2,#b7c3c8)}.ds-field textarea{display:block;width:calc(100% - 24px);margin-top:6px;min-height:80px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid var(--line-2,#3d484e);border-radius:9px;background:#151b1e;font:400 13px/1.45 var(--sans, Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);color:var(--tx,#f4f7f6);resize:vertical;caret-color:var(--ac,#64d4bd);transition:border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.ds-field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--tx-3,#9baab1);opacity:1}.ds-field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--ac,#64d4bd);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--ac-w,#203c36)}.ds-field textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ac,#64d4bd);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-field textarea{transition:none}}

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: The selected destination uses teal and an inset left indicator.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;height:41px;margin:3px 0;padding:0 10px;border-radius:5px;background:#23322f;box-shadow:inset 2px 0 var(--ac,#64d4bd);color:var(--ac,#64d4bd);font:500 13px/1 var(--sans, Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);text-decoration:none;transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.ds-nav svg{width:18px;height:18px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--raised,#22292d)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ac,#64d4bd);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none}}

components.name: Mode Chip
components.description: The unselected builder-mode chip; selected treatment is documented in DESIGN.md.
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;height:30px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--line,#2b3337);font:500 12px/1 var(--sans, Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);color:var(--tx-2,#b7c3c8);background:none;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.ds-chip:hover{border-color:var(--line-2,#3d484e);color:var(--tx,#f4f7f6)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ac,#64d4bd);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-chip{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Gem Agency is a compact operating workspace in graphite and teal. Neutral surfaces organize projects, tangible website output, decisions, and measured growth. The gemstone-G identity gives the workspace its recognizable signature; the surrounding interface remains restrained and readable.

The same visual language carries idea intake through delivery, review, and growth evidence. Emphasis comes from useful hierarchy, surface tone, and a clear action color. Preserve the distinction between completed builds and published websites, and show unavailable measurements as an explicit state.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite canvas with subtly separated neutral panels.
Teal actions and selection, with distinct semantic status colors.
Compact sans-serif hierarchy and aligned numerical evidence.
Persistent desktop navigation and a linear mobile workspace.
Actual website previews and the faceted gemstone-G identity.

rules.name: The Action Accent Rule
rules.body: Use teal for action, selection, focus, and measured chart marks. Preserve semantic colors for status.

rules.name: The Evidence Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Make the value and next action easy to scan, and keep source, status, and time context immediately adjacent.

rules.name: The Preserve the Workflow Rule
rules.body: Stack the surrounding content on small screens while retaining the board's horizontal stage order.

dos: Do reuse the graphite surfaces, teal action color, and compact sans-serif hierarchy.
Do pair status color with visible text and preserve keyboard focus.
Do use the gemstone-G asset and actual project previews where available.
Do keep measurement provenance and unavailable states visible.
Do preserve the five-lane reading order with horizontal scrolling on mobile.
donts: Don't revive the superseded amethyst atmosphere, serif core page headings, or decorative panel glow.
Don't use fabricated metrics or imply that a completed build is already published.
Don't force every page into the overview's dashboard composition.
Don't hide useful workflow steps to make the mobile layout fit.
